name: Meter
description: How much of a limit has been used, in water that turns yuzu and then camellia near the limit.

props.name: label
props.description: Label above the track, on the left.

props.name: maxValue
props.description: End of the range: the limit.

props.name: description
props.description: A line under the track, such as "8.6 GB of 10 GB".

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the formatted value to the right of the label.

props.name: thresholds
props.description: Percentages of the range where the fill turns yuzu and then camellia.

props.name: variant
props.description: One continuous 6px track, or ten separate blocks.

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: Text to show instead of the formatted value.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Meter.
